sources.title: GitHub - rasyosef/llama-3.2-amharic: A demo for the llama-3.2-amharic ...
sources.snippet: Llama 3.2 Amharic This is a demo for llama-3.2-amharic, a smaller version of Meta's Llama-3.2-1B decoder transformer model pretrained for 3 days on 210 million tokens of Amharic text. This model has 179 million parameters and a context size of 1024 tokens. This is a base model and hasn't undergone any supervised finetuing yet.
